## Pull Request Summary

### What does this PR do?

A clear description of the change and why it is needed.

### Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking — fixes an issue)
- [ ] Feature (non-breaking — adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fixes or features that cause existing behavior to change)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Validator improvement
- [ ] Profile update
- [ ] GitHub Actions / tooling

### AgentOS Checklist

- [ ] I have read `AGENTOS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- [ ] Validator passes: `python3 tools/scripts/validate_agentos.py` → 100/100
- [ ] Synthetic suite passes: `python3 validation/runner/execute_suite.py` → 21/21 PASS
- [ ] No new architecture introduced (unless fixing a critical defect)
- [ ] No stale version references (v0.1.0, etc.) added
- [ ] ADR created if an architectural decision was made
- [ ] `context/state.md` updated if applicable
- [ ] `DOCUMENTATION_INDEX.md` updated if new files were added
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated

### Files Changed

List the key files modified and why.

### Testing

Describe how you tested this change.

### Screenshots / Output (if applicable)

Paste validator output or relevant command output here.
